beats: Follow the coast road and defeat the first boy, who lets slip that the other has the necklace.
Navigate laundry and rubbish; Bram guards Ivo at the sofa.
Beat Ivo’s game, The Mending. He breaks his promise and demands a Pokémon battle.
After defeat he leads the child to the cupboard and hands over the necklace.
data.consequences: Only victory advances the battles. A completed minigame stays complete after later loss. A full pocket delays handover without repeating victories.

description:
A comic coastal theft becomes a visit to the boys’ lived-in squat, an unexpected horror game, and a broken promise before a small admission of wrongdoing.

Small-time immature thieves are not cosmic conspirators. Ivo’s apology does not establish the seller’s forgiveness.
name: The boys and the necklace
